task_completion.description: Fetch or download PDB structure 2ZTA (GCN4 leucine zipper) into the molecular viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The molecular viewer (e.g., PyMOL) shows the 2ZTA structure loaded, often indicated by the object name '2ZTA' in the object menu.

task_completion.description: Show both chains (A and B) as cartoons with distinct colors to highlight the parallel coiled-coil architecture.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two parallel alpha-helices are visible in the viewer, rendered as ribbons or cartoons, colored differently (e.g., green and cyan).

task_completion.description: Identify and display hydrophobic core residues (Leucines and Valines) at heptad 'a' and 'd' positions as sticks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Side chains of residues pointing toward the interface of the two helices are displayed in 'stick' representation.

task_completion.description: Measure the inter-helix Cα-Cα distance at one or more positions along the coil.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or dashed line is visible between the two helices with a numerical distance label in Angstroms (typically between 5-12 Å).

task_completion.description: Save a high-quality figure of the analysis to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal command confirms the export of 'gcn4_coiled_coil.png' to '/home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/'.

task_completion.description: Write a structural analysis report containing PDB ID, chain IDs, core residues, and measured distance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the content of 'gcn4_coiled_coil_report.txt' with the required structural details.

integrity.description: The agent used the molecular viewer's GUI or command line interface rather than just creating a dummy file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL/molecular viewer window active with the 2ZTA structure manipulated.

integrity.description: The distance measurement was actually performed within the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement label is rendered by the 3D engine of the molecular viewer, not just typed into a text file.

integrity.description: The agent selected the correct residues for the 'd' positions.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report or command history identifies Leucine residues at positions 5, 12, 19, and 26.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 2ZTA. It consists of two identical chains (A and B). The 'd' positions of the heptad repeat are Leucines at residues 5, 12, 19, and 26. The 'a' positions are typically Valines (residues 2, 9, 16, 23, 30). Inter-helix C-alpha distances for core residues are generally between 5.0 and 11.0 Angstroms. The figure must be saved to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/images/gcn4_coiled_coil.png and the report to /home/ga/PyMOL_Data/gcn4_coiled_coil_report.txt.
